::: {#exm-level-sets-linear}

#### Parallel level lines

Let $\modmemf{\vx} = 2x_1 + x_2 + 1$, so $\vcoef = \tp{(2, 1)}$ and $\coef{0} = 1$.
The level set at $c$ is the line $x_2 = c - 1 - 2x_1$.
For $c = -1, 0, 1$ the lines are $x_2 = -2 - 2x_1$, $x_2 = -1 - 2x_1$ and $x_2 = -2x_1$.
They all have slope $-2$ and differ only in the intercept, so they are parallel.

:::
